name: City Council Meeting; Special/Closed Session
agenda_text:
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

  To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City
  Council to take place at City Hall, 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA
  at 8:00 a.m. on Wednesday, February 1, 2017. The agenda for the special meeting with the
  items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

  Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on January 30, 2017, at 5:30 p.m.

  February 1, 2017
  8:00 a.m.
  Council Chambers of City Hall
  340 Palos Verdes Dr. West
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business
referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public
inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council
after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s office
during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may
call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and
documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to
persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please
contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a
disability-related modification or accommodation.

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA; SPECIAL MEETING
February 1, 2017
  1
 The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings;
however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment
shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested
to fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The City
Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order
of items shown on the agenda.

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R17-05
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 17-721

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL (8:00 AM)

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM(S)

CLOSED SESSION (8:00 a.m.)

This time has been set aside for the City Council to meet in a closed session to discuss the
matters listed below pursuant to Government Code §54956.1 The Mayor or City Attorney will
give an additional oral report regarding the closed session.

CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION
Government Code §54956.1
Spencer v. Lunada Bay Boys, et al; United States District Court Case No. 2:16-cv-2129

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

At the conclusion of the Closed Session, the Council may continue any item listed on the closed
session agenda to the Open Session agenda for discussion or to take formal action as it may
deem appropriate.

ADJOURNMENT TO AN ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING ON TUESDAY,
FEBRUARY 14, 2017 AT 6:30 P.M. IN COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE
PURPOSE OF A CLOSED SESSION AND REGULAR MEETING.

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA; SPECIAL MEETING
February 1, 2017
  2
 I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing
agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to
Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos
Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting in
accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 30th day of January, 2017.

  Vickie Kroneberger, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA; SPECIAL MEETING
February 1, 2017
